name: UMDAC Datathon 2024
description: Applied statistical analysis and machine learning to uncover insights from a cryptocurrency dataset. Project includes time-series analysis, risk profiling, and close price prediction to support smarter trading strategies and financial decision-making.

name: SAS Hackathon 2025
description: Developed LUCID, a smart-grid analytics solution during the SAS Hackathon 2025, using SAS Viya and open-source tools to analyse continuous IoT data streams, enabling predictive insights, fault detection, grid self-healing capabilities, reduced renewable energy waste, and improved operational efficiency.
